speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, how long have you been experiencing wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi infection) presenting with early disseminated symptoms including migratory arthritis (left knee), regional monoarthritis (left wrist), and systemic signs (fever, chills, malaise) following exposure in an endemic area (Minnesota).
